g.text: Between-condition difference of arm gaps: +0.58 pp
Both PLA arms show a similar condition gap
Lines link animal identities, not spatially matched tissue. Similar gaps motivate checking shared ChAT/detection effects;
they do not prove a shared mechanism or equivalent assays. Three animals per condition limit arm-selectivity claims.
